title: How to "CREATE" a lead through the API using Zapier
text:
## How to "CREATE" a lead through the API using Zapier
Link: https://support.brilliantdirectories.com/support/solutions/articles/12000102390
This article shows an example of how a Google Spreadsheet can be used to create a new lead while using the site's API.

## Checklist Before Moving Forward With This Example
1) Make sure to generate a unique API Key using the documentation down below as a guideline. Please make sure to save the API Key in a safe place as it is not accessible after it has been created:
How To Generate an API Key
2) Make sure to have a Google Spreadsheet ready. This spreadsheet should have at least one row of the lead information shown below:
[IMAGE: https://s3.amazonaws.com/cdn.freshdesk.com/data/helpdesk/attachments/production/12152725130/original/bnC9nbSdeSmDi4oFeLVYcKCqK3CoSnEdSQ.png?1731970885 | alt: ]
Please note the following required fields in order to create a lead:
lead_name
lead_email
lead_message
top_id
It should have the same variables found within the Website - Lead Form - Get Matched form.

## Connecting Google Sheets with Zapier
Log in to the Zapier account and click on + Create and click on Zaps :
[IMAGE: https://s3.amazonaws.com/cdn.freshdesk.com/data/helpdesk/attachments/production/12152726166/original/sKhjwgznhBE65tU0QY3TEcViSnqTnk3xoA.png?1731972309 | alt: ]
Click on Trigger and search for Google Sheet:
[IMAGE: https://s3.amazonaws.com/cdn.freshdesk.com/data/helpdesk/attachments/production/12152726179/original/uGAcNdBsBe7R3OKD9KB_g0nWp2v51r3MqQ.gif?1731972347 | alt: ]
Select New or Updated Spreadsheet Row for the Trigger event and log into your Google account, once done click on Continue:
[IMAGE: https://s3.amazonaws.com/cdn.freshdesk.com/data/helpdesk/attachments/production/12152726211/original/kxbxYgmvj9uGaHZgEXqj-hefUw4vxqDY4g.png?1731972388 | alt: ]
Select the Spreadsheet that has the lead information with the respective Worksheet. If necessary, select a Trigger Column or leave it as "any column" and click on Continue:
[IMAGE: https://s3.amazonaws.com/cdn.freshdesk.com/data/helpdesk/attachments/production/12152891645/original/qYWz1LVO4ShzcMuubQxwEcJ8uRgYjlqvGg.png?1732197268 | alt: ]
Click on Test Trigger and the Spreadsheet information will display as a preview:
[IMAGE: https://s3.amazonaws.com/cdn.freshdesk.com/data/helpdesk/attachments/production/12152891658/original/4Crt3KfJfOyOOCNALi--WykfUAPZGMP8SA.png?1732197297 | alt: ]
Click on Continue with the selected record for the next step in this process.

## Connecting the API with Zapier
A new set of options will appear, select the option for Brilliant Directories:
[IMAGE: https://s3.amazonaws.com/cdn.freshdesk.com/data/helpdesk/attachments/production/12152726402/original/JHQ_pmhLhLDetxgcmjgrWxQnYMLpdJ8dzw.gif?1731972779 | alt: ]
Select the Action Event to Create Lead and either choose a BD account if you've done this in the past or Connect a new account:
[IMAGE: https://s3.amazonaws.com/cdn.freshdesk.com/data/helpdesk/attachments/production/12152891786/original/8syEVUIFNqWwWhwOwwXGAxDaOGNCsz-qZQ.png?1732197432 | alt: ]
If this is the first time, click on Connect a new account and a popup will show up. Add the website URL and the API Key , and click Yes, Continue to Brilliant Directories:
[IMAGE: https://s3.amazonaws.com/cdn.freshdesk.com/data/helpdesk/attachments/production/12152891923/original/wgdfMHZR_86OZDtG8E_lMYHLnsKk1ZUBwQ.png?1732197507 | alt: ]
Once finished, click Continue.

## Configuring the Lead Information
The next step is to align the fields from your worksheet to the correct fields for the lead to be created.
[IMAGE: https://s3.amazonaws.com/cdn.freshdesk.com/data/helpdesk/attachments/production/12152892236/original/Mu83ugwUKZ3qlo7ajWFSLIBm5xQVlQ3tAA.gif?1732197800 | alt: ]
The next step will ask to test the trigger, and verify that everything went well:
[IMAGE: https://s3.amazonaws.com/cdn.freshdesk.com/data/helpdesk/attachments/production/12152892389/original/WsFJFxb1t6qb9pJkjAMsRQadHju-iXYwpQ.png?1732197935 | alt: ]
If done correctly, the lead will appear in your admin area Interactions - Member Leads:
When a lead is created via the API , the "Origin Page" will display the label "Received from External Source" both in the admin area or the member dashboard Which is a text label that can be edited under Settings >> Text Labels:
[IMAGE: https://s3.amazonaws.com/cdn.freshdesk.com/data/helpdesk/attachments/production/12162687958/original/7ahnNJ--tdXqb7-wAVZPQ82feq_RomRfLw.png?1749648418 | alt: ]
[IMAGE: https://s3.amazonaws.com/cdn.freshdesk.com/data/helpdesk/attachments/production/12162688150/original/c_wBlcBWXSa73ZbG_94DuDXW-DMogvsHug.png?1749648622 | alt: ]
[IMAGE: https://s3.amazonaws.com/cdn.freshdesk.com/data/helpdesk/attachments/production/12162688185/original/nAJiJxQYR0oP57VNjpJrZywJTWwsjKt_xg.png?1749648658 | alt: ]
